summary: This Form 8-K reports a standard asset-backed securitization (ABS) transaction for sub-prime auto loans. Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-1 will issue eight classes of notes totaling approximately $384.41 million, backed by auto loan receivables transferred by Exeter Finance LLC to depositor EFCAR, LLC. An underwriting agreement with Deutsche Bank, Citigroup, and Mizuho was signed May 19, 2026, for the sale of registered notes. The filing involves no merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special situation; it is a routine structured finance issuance. No deal terms such as premium or break fee are relevant.
